rubric.role_summary: Client-facing business lead overseeing commercial due diligence engagements for private equity clients, including project delivery, client relationships, and quality control of AI-assisted research.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Client-facing business lead overseeing commercial due diligence engagements for private equity clients, including project delivery, client relationships, and quality control of AI-assisted research.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience at an MBB firm, in private equity, or in investment banking.
- Experience with commercial due diligence.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Track record of managing complex, deadline-driven workstreams with multiple stakeholders.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

must_haves.requirement: 3+ years of experience at an MBB firm, in private equity, or in investment banking.
must_haves.source_quote: 3–6 years of experience at an MBB firm, in private equity, or in investment banking
Experience with commercial due diligence — you understand the methodology, the client expectations, and what separates a good CDD from a great one

location.requirement_text: Location: New York metropolitan area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: High ownership mentality and independent problem-solving
Genuine curiosity about AI and its implications for knowledge work
Start-up mentality and comfort with ownership, speed, variety, and hands-on work
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
